description: Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal is an open data portal listed in Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse. The portal lists 382 datasets published by Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse for Corsica; the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Corsica. 382 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 35 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-oddc-datacorsica-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
